provisional_name: Post-V836 Target A: neutral-cell callable primitive invention
reason_not_versioned: Do not start V837 until V836 is closed under the recovery rules.
research_question: Can one generic low-level cell substrate independently discover recurring computational motifs, promote them into callable primitives based on held-out reuse value, and reduce future search/compute without named high-level operators or task-family labels?
hypothesis: Across behaviorally different task families, repeated useful subgraphs will recur independently. A reuse-gated promoter can compress such motifs into callable units whose later reuse reduces candidate evaluations while preserving fresh held-out performance better than random or frequency-only promotion.
single_principal_change_from_existing_ne: Add evidence-gated motif compression and callable reuse; do not change the low-level cell substrate, benchmark families, objective, or resource model in the same variant.

allowed: generic cells with local internal state

baselines: same neutral substrate without primitive promotion
seed_policy: paired episode seeds across methods; fresh_audit seeds are never used for design, threshold selection, motif selection, or hyperparameter choice

development.independent_recurrence: At least one structurally/behaviorally equivalent motif must be discovered independently in at least 3 development runs and in at least 2 distinct benchmark families.
development.heldout_value: Promoted motif must improve validation performance or reduce validation candidate evaluations relative to no-promotion on paired seeds, with no benchmark family losing more than 2 percentage points absolute success rate.
development.callability: The compressed unit must be executable as a callable graph/program object without task-family-specific relabeling or hand-written family logic.
development.reuse_value: On validation tasks where the primitive is applicable, median candidate evaluations must be <= 0.75 times the no-promotion baseline while paired success rate is not lower by more than 2 percentage points.
development.promotion_specificity: Random-promotion and frequency-only promotion must not match the reuse-gated method on both success and candidate-evaluation cost.

fresh_audit.success_rate_requirement: Overall paired success rate must be no worse than no-promotion by more than 2 percentage points, and at least 4 of 5 families must be non-inferior by the same margin.
fresh_audit.search_cost_requirement: For applicable reused motifs, median candidate evaluations must remain <= 0.80 times no-promotion.
fresh_audit.reuse_requirement: At least one previously promoted primitive must be automatically retrieved and reused on a fresh combination not used during motif promotion.
fresh_audit.structural_restraint: On an adequate negative-control family, primitive promotion count must be zero or statistically indistinguishable from the no-useful-motif null calibration fixed during development.

negative_controls: task already solved within the cheap-search adequacy budget: no primitive should be promoted
one-off noise motif: no primitive should be promoted
repeated motif with no held-out benefit: frequency alone must not cause promotion
